title: Cedar Basin Organizational Sensemaking Fixture Report
summary: Multiple synthetic records establish Riverwatch readiness as delayed due to pending Silt Sensor acceptance, contradicting an earlier registered 'ready' status from a prior date. Dependencies link Riverwatch deployment to Northline Instruments shipping schedules.

findings.claim: Riverwatch readiness status is recorded as delayed.
findings.qualification: Synthetic annotations and text records state readiness is delayed pending sensor acceptance.

findings.claim: Riverwatch Pilot depends on Silt Sensor Batch acceptance.
findings.qualification: Dependency review explicitly links pilot deployment to sensor acceptance completion.

findings.claim: Earlier readiness register indicates ready status.
findings.qualification: Record from 2026-09-03 predates dependency review and has not been reconciled.

findings.claim: Northline Instruments shipping schedule is revised.
findings.qualification: Expected arrival moved from 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-19; no physical delivery confirmed.
